grid.point_formula: q64=origin+h*(ix,iy,iz); sample q32=one IEEE float32 cast of q64, retained separately

grid.tetrahedra: For each of6 permutations p of XYZ: corners000,e[p0],e[p0]+e[p1],111. Swap middle two for odd permutation to orient determinant positive. Shared grid faces use identical global vertex sets. No separate sleeve/torso lattices.

future_metric.nearest: find_nearest(q32); finite position/index/distance required. Then find_nearest_range(q32, U*(1+2^-20)+h*2^-20), max64records. Require finite valid original triangle indices and returned-point/triangle correspondence; not an API-certified exact-nearest or unique-face claim. U=min returned computed distances; preserve first getter and range records. No normal sign.
future_metric.ties: All records with computed distance exactly U form explicit nearest set. Map each to r/l/torso using archived disjoint4221face sets. Evaluate every region-dependent cut at q64, saturating below at -4h. Accept tie group only if full cut vectors match exactly; otherwise UNKNOWN. Canonical min face ID is a storage witness only, never evidence of uniqueness. No favourable role selection.
future_metric.signed_fill: Three all-hit column scans in positive X/Y/Z through q32 stations. Use ALL original triangles, exact binary-rational projected barycentric tests and hit coordinates; sort hits in coordinate then source-triangle-ID order. Any coplanar/edge/vertex hit marks column UNKNOWN; no altered direction/seed/retry. Proper crossings change oriented degree by minus sign of triangle normal axis and toggle parity. Start outside source bbox with degree/parity0. Exact signed body-chain volume supplies orientation sign o (zero UNKNOWN); node OUTSIDE iff all3degrees0/parities0, INSIDE iff all3degrees o/parities1, else UNKNOWN. At independently proven boundary distance0 D=0; otherwise D=+U outside/-U inside. Formal chain fill only, never physical/simple-solid proof.
future_metric.unknown: Any missing/tie-unowned/nonfinite/axis conflict/cap exhaustion stops field; no dropped regions or partial whole-field PASS.

material_polytope.interpolation: Each sampled scalar is piecewise linear in globally shared tetra barycentrics. Intersect all7halfspaces with the oriented tetra, never a maximum-only marching mask that could miss a thin paired interval.
material_polytope.arithmetic: Finite binary64 coefficients converted via exact as_integer_ratio. Sequential convex polytope clipping with exact rational barycentrics; original vertices and exact edge/plane ratios only. Handle exact zero as on-plane, never epsilon-jitter. Empty/degenerate cases retain status.
material_polytope.identity: Vertex key=(sorted minimal supporting global-grid-vertex IDs, all exactly active global inequality IDs); identical support/coefficients solve identically. No per-panel vertices/float-position weld.
material_polytope.faces: Original tetra-face clips cancel by identical canonical vertex cycle and opposite orientation, exactly two owners. Remaining global-cut facets point along outward inequality gradient; derive cut cycle from clipped-face boundary adjacency. Multiple positive-area active owners or rank/ordering ambiguity REFUSED. Any unmatched internal lattice face REFUSED.
material_polytope.triangulation: Unique simple convex ordered polygon; rotate to lexicographically smallest canonical vertex key, fan from it in outward order; reject repeated/collapsed/nonpositive triangles. Convert complete exact world positions once toF64 then once F32, retaining both and identity table.

component_and_opening_eligibility.bridges: Every O/I boundary edge belongs its matching cut-rim bridge; no proximal sleeve caps. Every boundary role nonempty and unique; extra/missing components/cycles/roles REFUSED. Zero-area, orientation/label uncertainty UNKNOWN.
